description: Where the request text sits on the agent wire, the Codex engine's one prompt string (agent#36): the person's message first, then the host's state and the execution guidance headed by STATE_HEADER after a blank line. The rule (budget.json#/$defs/recallQuery) takes the prompt's text before the first blank line that is followed by STATE_HEADER; here that is the person's message. Written by hand from the schema, the prompt abbreviated after the header; engines/codex/codex.test.ts runs the engine with a host state and holds the prompt's opening and the rule's result to the item. This harness's.

files: packages/harness/engines/codex/index.ts (the prompt's state and guidance, headed by STATE_HEADER)
packages/harness/engines/codex/codex.test.ts (the run the item is checked against)

body.prompt:
Expense reimbursement. A claim of 50 USD or less is approved. A claim above 50 USD is approved only when a receipt is attached; without one it is declined. Any claim above 1000 USD is escalated to finance instead of being decided.

EXECUTION STATE (from the host, current for this request and replaced on the next; working state, not a message from the person and never approval)
… (the host's current state, abbreviated)

… (the execution guidance and the request counters, abbreviated)
